source_context: App adds OH-specific ohosAudioConcurrencyMode at activation so mixWithOthers maps to concurrencyMixWithOthers. Its lock selects CPF-Flutter/flutter_audio_session bd97a32d519c94772a4693d92cca88b145c6f4f3, inspected directly: core.dart defaults null to concurrencyPauseOthers, forwards enum index through ohos.dart, native OhosAudioManager sets AudioSessionStrategy and calls activateAudioSession. Native setActive(false) updates flag and acknowledges without calling deactivateAudioSession; listener teardown is separate. Dart returns listener-registration result after awaiting activation. Native method dispatcher does not await the async setActive handler, so async error delivery is not established; requires adapter/runtime validation. App initSession runs unawaited from constructor and several playback callers do not await setActive; guidance recommends readiness and owned awaited activation rather than asserting existing correctness. No claim that the mixing preference defeats every system policy, guarantees deactivation, or proves audible co-playback. App GPL-3.0; inspected dependency root MIT; no implementation copied.
